lede: San Francisco 49ers carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#2 in EPA per play) and the better defensive rating with it, so the ratings point the same way on both sides of the ball.
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it San Francisco 49ers -8.2 with a fair total of 49.7, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is San Francisco 49ers pass offence vs Washington Commanders pass defence, which sits +0.360 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is availability: NFL injury report — not loaded in this session.
